eyebrow: Computing G_t in one backward pass
code:
def compute_returns(rewards, gamma=0.99):
    returns = []
    G = 0.0
    for r in reversed(rewards):
        G = r + gamma * G
        returns.insert(0, G)
    return returns
caption: G_t = r_t + gamma * G_(t+1) — O(T), not O(T^2)
